title: Introductions
description: Introduce yourself and get someone to open up.

questions.sentence: Aap ka naam kya hai?
options: Mera naam {name} hai.
Main Lucknow se hoon.
Main theek hoon, shukriya.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera naam {name} hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My name is {name}.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan se hain?
options: Main Hyderabad se hoon.
Mera naam Ali hai.
Ji haan, main aa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Hyderabad se hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am from Hyderabad.

questions.sentence: Main Karachi se hoon.
options: I am from Karachi.
I live in Lahore.
I am going to Karachi.
questions.correctAnswer: I am from Karachi.

questions.sentence: Assalam alaikum, main Ayesha hoon.
options: Walaikum assalam, main Bilal hoon.
Khuda hafiz, phir milenge.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Walaikum assalam, main Bilal hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Peace be upon you too, I am Bilal.

questions.sentence: Mera naam Bilal hai.
options: My name is Bilal.
His name is Bilal.
My brother is Bilal.
questions.correctAnswer: My name is Bilal.

questions.sentence: Kya aap Dilli mein rehte hain?
options: Ji haan, main Dilli mein rehta hoon.
Ji haan, main Dilli jaa raha hoon.
Ji nahin, mujhe Dilli ka rasta maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, main Dilli mein rehta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I live in Delhi.

questions.sentence: Main Lucknow mein rehta hoon.
options: I live in Lucknow.
We live in Lucknow.
I am going to Lucknow.
questions.correctAnswer: I live in Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Aap ka taalluq kahan se hai?
options: Mera taalluq Lucknow se hai.
Mera naam Sara hai.
Main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera taalluq Lucknow se hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am from Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Main yahan naya hoon.
options: I am new here.
I am not from here.
I am here right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am new here.

questions.sentence: Aap ki umar kitni hai?
options: Meri umar tees saal hai.
Main tees saal se yahan hoon.
Mera ghar tees minute door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Meri umar tees saal hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am thirty years old.

questions.sentence: Aap kya kaam karte hain?
options: Main ek doctor hoon.
Main abhi kaam par jaa raha hoon.
Mujhe apna kaam bohat pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ek doctor hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am a doctor.

questions.sentence: Main ek ustaad hoon.
options: I am a teacher.
I am a student.
He is a teacher.
questions.correctAnswer: I am a teacher.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan kaam karte hain?
options: Main ek hospital mein kaam karta hoon.
Main subah saat baje kaam karta hoon.
Main doctor banna chahta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ek hospital mein kaam karta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a hospital.

questions.sentence: Meri umar pachees saal hai.
options: I am twenty-five years old.
My brother is twenty-five years old.
I have been here for twenty-five years.
questions.correctAnswer: I am twenty-five years old.

questions.sentence: Kya aap talib-e-ilm hain?
options: Ji haan, main Dilli mein parhta hoon.
Ji haan, mera bhai ustaad hai.
Ji nahin, mujhe parhna pasand nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, main Dilli mein parhta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I study in Delhi.

questions.sentence: Main {name} hoon aur main ek engineer hoon.
options: I am {name} and I am an engineer.
I am {name} and I want to become an engineer.
I am {name} and my brother is an engineer.
questions.correctAnswer: I am {name} and I am an engineer.

questions.sentence: Aap kitne saal se yeh kaam kar rahe hain?
options: Main paanch saal se yeh kaam kar raha hoon.
Main paanch baje kaam shuru karta hoon.
Mujhe yeh kaam bachpan se pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main paanch saal se yeh kaam kar raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I have been doing this work for five years.

questions.sentence: Main abhi kaam nahin karta, main parhta hoon.
options: I do not work right now, I am studying.
I am not studying right now, I work.
I work and I study as well.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not work right now, I am studying.

questions.sentence: Aap kaun si zubaanen bolte hain?
options: Main Urdu aur Angrezi bolta hoon.
Main Urdu ek saal se seekh raha hoon.
Mujhe Urdu ki shayari bohat pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Urdu aur Angrezi bolta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I speak Urdu and English.

questions.sentence: Kya aap ko Urdu aati hai?
options: Ji haan, thodi thodi aati hai.
Ji haan, meri behen Urdu parhati hai.
Ji nahin, mujhe seekhne ka waqt nahin milta.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, thodi thodi aati hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I know a little.

questions.sentence: Main sirf thodi si Urdu bolta hoon.
options: I only speak a little Urdu.
I speak Urdu very well.
I want to learn a little Urdu.
questions.correctAnswer: I only speak a little Urdu.

questions.sentence: Aap ne Urdu kahan seekhi?
options: Main ne Urdu Lucknow mein seekhi thi.
Main Urdu roz ghar par bolta hoon.
Mujhe Urdu likhna abhi nahin aata.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ne Urdu Lucknow mein seekhi thi.
questions.translatedSentence: I learned Urdu in Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Meri maadari zubaan Urdu hai.
options: Urdu is my mother tongue.
My mother speaks Urdu.
I am learning the Urdu language.
questions.correctAnswer: Urdu is my mother tongue.

questions.sentence: Aap Urdu kaise seekh rahe hain?
options: Main roz apne dost se Urdu mein baat karta hoon.
Main Urdu bachpan se bolta aa raha hoon.
Main Urdu isliye seekhta hoon ke mujhe achhi lagti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main roz apne dost se Urdu mein baat karta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I speak Urdu with my friend every day.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Angrezi aati hai lekin meri Urdu behtar hai.
options: I know English, but my Urdu is better.
I know Urdu, but English is easier for me.
I know English and Urdu equally well.
questions.correctAnswer: I know English, but my Urdu is better.

questions.sentence: Zara aahista boliye, meri Urdu abhi kamzor hai.
options: Koi baat nahin, main aahista bolta hoon.
Shukriya, aap ki Urdu bohat achhi hai.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe Urdu bilkul nahin aati.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahin, main aahista bolta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, I will speak slowly.

questions.sentence: Agar main galti karoon to aap mujhe theek kar dijiye.
options: If I make a mistake, please correct me.
If you make a mistake, I will correct you.
I make a lot of mistakes when I speak.
questions.correctAnswer: If I make a mistake, please correct me.

questions.sentence: Main Karachi se hoon, aur aap?
options: Main Hyderabad se hoon, mera saara khandaan wahin hai.
Ji haan, Karachi bohat bara sheher hai.
Mujhe Karachi ki biryani bohat pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main Hyderabad se hoon, mera saara khandaan wahin hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am from Hyderabad, my whole family is there.

questions.sentence: Aap ke ghar mein kitne log hain?
options: How many people are there in your family?
How many rooms does your house have?
Who else lives in your house?
questions.correctAnswer: How many people are there in your family?

questions.sentence: Aap ka koi bhai ya behen hai?
options: Ji haan, meri ek choti behen hai.
Ji haan, mera ek bohat achha dost hai.
Ji nahin, mere waalid Lucknow mein rehte hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, meri ek choti behen hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have a younger sister.

questions.sentence: Aap ko yeh sheher kaisa laga?
options: Mujhe yahan ke log aur yahan ki tehzeeb bohat pasand aayi.
Main is sheher mein paida hua tha.
Yeh sheher yahan se bohat door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe yahan ke log aur yahan ki tehzeeb bohat pasand aayi.
questions.translatedSentence: I really liked the people here and the manners of this place.

questions.sentence: Aap yahan kitne dinon se hain?
options: How long have you been here?
How many more days will you stay here?
When exactly did you get here?
questions.correctAnswer: How long have you been here?

questions.sentence: Aap khali waqt mein kya karte hain?
options: Main aksar mushaira sunne jaata hoon.
Main subah bohat jaldi uthta hoon.
Mere paas aaj bilkul waqt nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main aksar mushaira sunne jaata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I often go to poetry evenings.

questions.sentence: Kya main aap se ek baat pooch sakta hoon?
options: May I ask you something?
Could you tell me something?
I want to say one thing to you.
questions.correctAnswer: May I ask you something?

questions.sentence: Aap ko yahan ka khana kaisa lagta hai?
options: Nihari mujhe bohat pasand hai, lekin thodi teekhi hai.
Main roz ghar par hi khana banata hoon.
Mujhe abhi bhook nahin hai, shukriya.
questions.correctAnswer: Nihari mujhe bohat pasand hai, lekin thodi teekhi hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I love nihari, but it is a little too spicy.

questions.sentence: Main pooch raha tha ke aap kitne saal se Dilli mein hain.
options: I was asking how many years you have been in Delhi.
I was asking when you are going to Delhi.
I asked whether you like living in Delhi.
questions.correctAnswer: I was asking how many years you have been in Delhi.

questions.sentence: Yeh mera dost Imran hai.
options: Aap se mil kar khushi hui, Imran sahab.
Imran abhi kahan gaya hai?
Main Imran ko bilkul nahin jaanta.
questions.correctAnswer: Aap se mil kar khushi hui, Imran sahab.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a pleasure to meet you, Imran.

questions.sentence: Yeh meri behen Sana hai, woh Hyderabad mein parhti hai.
options: This is my sister Sana, she studies in Hyderabad.
This is my sister Sana, she works in Hyderabad.
My sister Sana is coming here from Hyderabad.
questions.correctAnswer: This is my sister Sana, she studies in Hyderabad.

questions.sentence: Kya aap dono ek doosre ko jaante hain?
options: Ji haan, hum ek hi daftar mein kaam karte hain.
Ji nahin, main abhi ghar jaa raha hoon.
Ji haan, main unhen abhi bula leta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, hum ek hi daftar mein kaam karte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we work in the same office.

questions.sentence: Imran sahab kya kaam karte hain?
options: Woh ek bare hospital mein doctor hain.
Woh pichhle hafte Karachi se aaye hain.
Woh meri behen ke purane dost hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh ek bare hospital mein doctor hain.
questions.translatedSentence: He is a doctor at a big hospital.

questions.sentence: Main aap ko apne dost se milwana chahta hoon.
options: I would like to introduce you to my friend.
I would like to meet your friend.
My friend would like to meet you.
questions.correctAnswer: I would like to introduce you to my friend.

questions.sentence: Aap ki mulaqat Sana se kab hui thi?
options: Hamari mulaqat pichhle saal Lucknow mein hui thi.
Main Sana ke ghar chai peene jaa raha hoon.
Sana meri behen ki sab se achhi dost hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Hamari mulaqat pichhle saal Lucknow mein hui thi.
questions.translatedSentence: We met last year in Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Yeh mera purana dost hai, hum bachpan mein ek saath parhte the.
options: This is my old friend; we studied together as children.
This is my old friend; we work together now.
My old friend and I went to school in the same city.
questions.correctAnswer: This is my old friend; we studied together as children.

questions.sentence: Tashreef rakhiye, main aap ke liye chai laata hoon.
options: Bohat meherbani, chai zaroor pilaiye.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe abhi nikalna hai.
Shukriya, lekin mujhe chai banani nahin aati.
questions.correctAnswer: Bohat meherbani, chai zaroor pilaiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you so much, I would love some tea.

questions.sentence: Agar aap ko waqt ho to meri ammi se bhi mil lijiye.
options: If you have time, please meet my mother as well.
If I have time, I will meet your mother too.
My mother would like to meet you some day.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have time, please meet my mother as well.

questions.sentence: Aap ka number kya hai? Main aap ko message karunga.
options: Main abhi aap ko apna number bhej deta hoon.
Mera phone ghar par reh gaya hai, maaf kijiye.
Aap ka number mere paas mehfooz hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main abhi aap ko apna number bhej deta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I will send you my number right now.

questions.sentence: Agar aap ko waqt mile to mujhe zaroor call kijiye.
options: If you get some time, do give me a call.
When I get some time, I will call you.
Please call me before you come over.
questions.correctAnswer: If you get some time, do give me a call.

questions.sentence: Aap se mil kar bohat khushi hui.
options: Mujhe bhi, aap se baat kar ke bohat achha laga.
Ji haan, main aap ko pehle se jaanta hoon.
Shukriya, lekin main yahan naya nahin hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi, aap se baat kar ke bohat achha laga.
questions.translatedSentence: Likewise, it was lovely talking to you.

questions.sentence: Main aap ko apna pata bhej deta hoon taake aap ghar aa saken.
options: I will send you my address so that you can come over.
I will send you my address as soon as I reach home.
Send me your address so that I can come over.
questions.correctAnswer: I will send you my address so that you can come over.

questions.sentence: Aglay hafte mushaira hai, kya aap aayenge?
options: Zaroor aaunga, agar kaam se jaldi farigh ho gaya.
Ji haan, main pichhle hafte mushaire mein tha.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe shayari samajh nahin aati.
questions.correctAnswer: Zaroor aaunga, agar kaam se jaldi farigh ho gaya.
questions.translatedSentence: I will definitely come, if I finish work early.

questions.sentence: Mujhe abhi nikalna hai, lekin hum phir milenge.
options: I have to leave now, but we will meet again.
I do not want to leave, but we will meet again.
I am leaving now, so we will not meet again.
questions.correctAnswer: I have to leave now, but we will meet again.

questions.sentence: Khuda hafiz, apna khayal rakhiye.
options: Khuda hafiz, aap bhi apna khayal rakhiyega.
Ji, main abhi ghar se nikal raha hoon.
Shukriya, main aaj sara din ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Khuda hafiz, aap bhi apna khayal rakhiyega.
questions.translatedSentence: Goodbye, you take care of yourself too.

questions.sentence: Kya main aap ka number kisi aur ko de sakta hoon?
options: Ji nahin, meherbani kar ke kisi ko mat dijiye.
Ji haan, mera number kal hi badal gaya hai.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe aap ka number maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji nahin, meherbani kar ke kisi ko mat dijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: No, please do not give it to anyone.

questions.sentence: Agar main Karachi aaya to aap ko pehle ittila kar doonga.
options: If I come to Karachi, I will let you know beforehand.
When you come to Karachi, let me know first.
I came to Karachi, but I did not tell you.
questions.correctAnswer: If I come to Karachi, I will let you know beforehand.
